name: exp_Amstell
summary: The Amstell EA is a mean reversion trading system that identifies overbought and oversold market conditions using a combination of oscillators and volatility indicators. It enters trades when price deviates significantly from its statistical mean, expecting a return to equilibrium. The EA incorporates dynamic stop loss and take profit levels based on ATR volatility measures.
summary_zh: Amstell EA是一个均值回归交易系统，通过振荡器和波动率指标识别市场超买超卖状态。当价格显著偏离统计均值时入场交易，预期价格回归均衡。该EA使用基于ATR波动率的动态止损止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用均值回归策略，核心概念是价格在偏离均值后终将回归。入场条件基于RSI超买超卖信号结合布林带偏离度确认，当RSI低于超卖阈值且价格触及布林带下轨时做多，反之做空。出场条件包括动态止盈止损和均值回归目标位，止损基于ATR倍数设定以适应市场波动。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式，确保每笔交易风险可控。资金管理方面建议单笔风险不超过账户净值的2%，同时EA包含最大持仓限制防止过度暴露。整体策略逻辑清晰，但均值回归在强趋势市场中可能面临连续亏损风险。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a mean reversion strategy based on the core concept that prices tend to revert to their statistical mean after significant deviations. Entry conditions utilize RSI overbought/oversold signals confirmed by Bollinger Band deviations — going long when RSI drops below the oversold threshold and price touches the lower Bollinger Band, and vice versa for shorts. Exit conditions include dynamic stop loss and take profit levels calculated using ATR multiples to adapt to current market volatility, along with mean reversion target prices. Position sizing supports both fixed lot and percentage-based account balance calculation methods, ensuring controlled risk per trade. Money management recommends single-trade risk not exceeding 2% of account equity, with maximum position limits to prevent overexposure. The overall strategy logic is clear, but mean reversion can face consecutive losses during strong trending markets.

pros: 基于ATR的动态止损止盈能适应不同市场波动环境
多指标确认入场信号减少假信号交易
风险百分比仓位管理确保每笔交易风险可控
最大持仓限制防止过度暴露风险
均值回归策略在震荡市中有较高胜率
pros_en: ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit adapt to varying market volatility conditions
Multi-indicator confirmation on entry signals reduces false signal trades
Risk percentage position sizing ensures controlled risk per trade
Maximum position limits prevent excessive risk exposure
Mean reversion strategy achieves higher win rates in ranging markets
cons: 均值回归策略在强趋势市场中可能连续止损
缺少趋势过滤器来避免逆势交易
没有新K线检查可能导致同一信号重复入场
缺少点差过滤在高位差时可能不利
回撤在极端行情下可能超出预期
cons_en: Mean reversion strategy can suffer consecutive stop losses in strong trending markets
Lacks a trend filter to avoid counter-trend trades
Missing new bar check may cause duplicate entries on the same signal
No spread filter may result in unfavorable entries during high spread conditions
Drawdowns may exceed expectations during extreme market conditions
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如大周期均线方向）避免逆势交易
添加新K线检查和时间框架过滤防止重复入场
加入点差过滤和交易时段限制提升执行质量
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., higher timeframe MA direction) to avoid counter-trend trades
Implement new bar check and timeframe filtering to prevent duplicate entries
Add spread filter and trading session restrictions to improve execution quality

risk_points: 缺少趋势过滤器可能在单边行情中持续逆势亏损
无新K线检查可能导致信号重复入场放大风险
均值回归策略在黑天鹅事件中面临尾部风险
risk_points_en: Lack of trend filter may cause sustained counter-trend losses in directional markets
No new bar check may lead to duplicate entries amplifying risk on same signal
Mean reversion strategy faces tail risk during black swan events
